# FluffyTamer

> FluffyTamer is an e-commerce storefront specializing in cat-themed apparel and merchandise with playful, graphic designs.

FluffyTamer offers a curated collection of cat-inspired clothing and accessories built on Shopify. The shop features a variety of products ranging from funny graphic tees to novelty hats, appealing to cat lovers and enthusiasts of quirky animal apparel.

- Graphic t-shirts

- New year sales
